# QR matrix encoder

The `QRCode/` files are copied from
`qrcode-terminal@0.12.0`, `vendor/QRCode/`:
https://github.com/gtanner/qrcode-terminal/tree/v0.12.0/vendor/QRCode

Trailing whitespace has been removed; the code is otherwise unchanged.
The package's Apache License 2.0 is included in `LICENSE`. The original
`QRCode/index.js` retains Kazuhiko Arase's MIT copyright and license notice,
as well as the notice of Node-specific modifications. `LICENSE-MIT` includes
the MIT license text. The local `package.json` selects CommonJS for the
unchanged source inside this ESM project; it adds no dependencies.
